name: DAAD Study Scholarships
desc: Monthly stipend for Master's study in Germany, awarded on academic merit and motivation.
tips: Strong motivation letter tied to a specific German programme
Check if your chosen course is on the DAAD-eligible list

name: Public universities in Germany (low or no tuition)
desc: Many public universities charge little or no tuition for Master's, so the main cost is living expenses.
tips: Budget for proof of living funds for visa

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's
desc: Multi-country Master's programmes with scholarship options, applied to through each programme.
tips: Apply per programme, each has its own deadline
Rankings are competitive, apply to several

name: Research assistantships (thesis-based Master's)
desc: Thesis MSc programmes often come with funding from a supervisor's grant. Contacting professors early matters most.
tips: Email professors whose papers match your projects
Attach a short, specific research pitch

name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS)
desc: Provincial merit scholarship for graduate students at Ontario universities, applied for through the university.
tips: Applied via your host department after admission or alongside it

name: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship
desc: Funded research internship at Canadian universities for international undergraduates. Good way to build contacts before applying for a Master's.
tips: Good fit while still a final-year undergrad
Pick projects close to your ML work

name: NUS / NTU research scholarships
desc: Research-based programmes in Singapore usually pair admission with a funded scholarship.
tips: Research track is better funded than coursework
Prior research output strengthens the case a lot

name: SINGA (PhD pathway)
desc: Fully funded PhD award in Singapore. Only relevant if you are open to a PhD instead of a Master's.
tips: Consider after a Master's or strong undergrad research
